Objective: Adrian navigates the immediate logistical and emotional aftermath of his enrollment, establishing the routine of his new financial lifeline while processing the humiliation and relief of his decision.
IntendedChange: Adrian transitions from the shock of signing the contract to the practical reality of his new daily obligation, securing his first payment and stabilizing his immediate financial crisis.
ProhibitedPatterns: Do not introduce a new medical emergency or side effect that contradicts the 'low-risk' nature of the trial established in Chapter 1.
Do not have Adrian encounter Lena Reyes or any other major character from the future plotlines.
Do not reveal the nanites or any supernatural element; the world must remain strictly mundane and scientific.
Do not have Adrian skip his first dose or fail to collect his first specimen; the resolution criteria require these actions to be completed.

Scenes.Purpose: Adrian returns to his cramped apartment, physically manifesting the exhaustion and hunger that drove his decision, and immediately addresses his most urgent physical need (food) to ground the stakes of his financial desperation.
Scenes.IntendedChange: Establishes the baseline of Adrian's destitution and the immediate, tangible benefit of the trial (access to food/money) before the administrative details are processed.

Scenes.Purpose: Adrian reviews the detailed participant handbook and schedule provided by Dr. Aris, confronting the specific, undignified requirements of the daily specimen collection and the strict timing of the medication, highlighting the bureaucratic absurdity of his new life.
Scenes.IntendedChange: Clarifies the specific rules and constraints of the trial for the reader and Adrian, setting up the logistical challenge of balancing this with his academic and work life.

Scenes.Purpose: Adrian takes his first dose of the fertility drug, observing the mundane, clinical nature of the pill and the strange, quiet emptiness of his apartment, reflecting on the trade-off between his dignity and his survival.
Scenes.IntendedChange: Completes the 'initial dose' resolution criterion, marking the point of no return in his physical involvement with the trial.

Scenes.Purpose: Adrian visits the university registrar or financial aid office to confirm that the trial payments will be recognized as legitimate income for his tuition and rent, experiencing a moment of bureaucratic relief and validation for his risky choice.
Scenes.IntendedChange: Secures the 'funding for tuition and rent' objective, providing a concrete victory and reducing the immediate financial pressure that defined Chapter 1.

Scenes.Purpose: Adrian returns to the hospital clinic for his first daily specimen collection, navigating the sterile, impersonal environment and the physical discomfort of the procedure, emphasizing the routine and repetitive nature of his new burden.
Scenes.IntendedChange: Completes the 'first daily specimen collection' resolution criterion, fully establishing his role as an active participant in the trial.

Scenes.Purpose: Adrian receives his first weekly payment and purchases a substantial, high-quality meal, savoring the taste and fullness as a direct reward for his compliance, ending the chapter on a note of cautious, earned satisfaction rather than anxiety.
Scenes.IntendedChange: Provides a positive emotional resolution to the short arc's initial setup, allowing the reader to feel the weight of his success before the next arc begins.
